test_title: PYST 27: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 10 Aug, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**Parts of a sentence are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the parts in the correct order to form a meaningful sentence.**

A. agenda for sustainable development

B. as the world faces cascading and

C. interlinked global crises and conflicts

D. the aspirations set out in the 2030

E. are in jeopardy
solution:
The correct answer is: **BCDAE**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Part B**: This part introduces the context or the condition under which something is happening.
 
• **Part C**: This builds upon the previous part, describing the challenges the world is currently dealing with.
 
• **Part D**: This part specifies the timeframe and purpose, indicating that there are certain goals or objectives set for the year 2030.
 
• **Part A**: This connects with the previous part, revealing that the mentioned goals are part of a broader agenda focused on sustainable development.
 
• **Part E**: This concludes the sentence by stating that the goals or agenda for sustainable development are at risk or in danger due to the global crises and conflicts.

Therefore, **option 3** is the correct answer.
